visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a crowded urban outdoor street under rainy conditions. A blonde-haired man wearing glasses and a light grey shirt interacts excitedly with a crowd of people holding colorful umbrellas. Beside him, a black-haired man in a black jacket observes. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to a pink-themed event booth. The blonde man sits on a large purple exercise ball, aiming a purple ball at a basketball hoop set against a blue-grid background. Onlookers are visible behind a barrier. (3) The men are seen inside a photo booth environment, wearing purple track jackets with event logos. They pose playfully for the camera, followed by a close-up of printed photo strips held by a hand. (4) The duo interacts with a large transparent capsule machine filled with colorful balls. They turn the dial, retrieve a capsule, and excitedly show a prize card to the camera. (5) A series of close-up shots showcase promotional products, including various flavors of boxed candies, a branded purple power bank, and scented candles. The lighting is bright and studio-like within the booth. (6) The final phase shows the two men standing in front of a large promotional backdrop, holding signs and waving to the camera as the event details are displayed via graphic overlays.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a rainy street in Ximending with shop signs and umbrellas to a highly branded pink and blue pop-up event booth for HI-CHEW, featuring basketball hoops and prize displays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music plays continuously in the background. The main speaker (瑋瑋) narrates with an excited, fast-paced tone, punctuated by short laughing sounds. Ambient noise of rain and a murmuring crowd is audible but ducked under the narration. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as a ball hits the basketball rim. This is followed by a loud 'cheer' sound effect from a crowd. (3) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during the scene change to the photo booth. The two speakers have a brief, overlapping conversational exchange with high pitch variability. (4) A mechanical clicking sound of the capsule machine turning is heard, followed by a 'pop' bubble SFX when the capsule opens. The speakers' voices rise in volume and arousal during the prize reveal. (5) Fast-paced vocal delivery continues as the speakers list prizes. Occasional 'sparkle' or 'magic' synth SFX emphasize the product close-ups. (6) The final phase features a rhythmic synth melody with clear beat strength, as the speakers sign off with a warm, friendly tone over fading cheering sounds.
